## adopt

```json
      "as"

  "doc": "refactory/docs/cli.md",
```

## profile-save

```json
      "target",

        "enable",
        "disable"
      ],
      "flags": [],
      "nargs": null,
      "position": 0,

      "required": true,
      "type": "string"
    },
    "target": {
      "default": "",
      "description": "",
      "flags": [],
      "nargs": "?",
      "position": 1,
      "positional": true,
      "required": false,
      "type": "string"
    }
  },
  "purpose": "Discover or manage mode packages using registered subcommands. Enabling/importing packages changes live discovery without rebuilding docs.",
```

## steer

Read or append to the run’s intent ledger. CLI/panel also expose gate answers and boundary controls; chat only exposes notes, constraints and seed.

Documentation: [refactory/docs/cli.md](../../../refactory/docs/cli.md)

```json
{
  "chat": {
    "fields": {
      "intent": "seed",
      "kind": "kind",
      "note": "note",
      "run": "run",
      "runsRoot": "runs_root"
    },
    "order": [
      "run",
      "runsRoot",
      "intent",
      "note",
      "kind"
    ],
    "required": [
      "run"
    ]
  },
  "description": "what this run is for, and what has been said since",
  "doc": "refactory/docs/cli.md",
  "examples": [
    {
      "arguments": {
        "kind": "constraint",
        "note": "Keep the output text unchanged",
        "run": "/tmp/example-run"
      },
      "explanation": "Read or append to the run\u2019s intent ledger. CLI/panel also expose gate answers and boundary controls; chat only exposes notes, constraints and seed."
    }
  ],
  "interfaces": {
    "chat": "refactory action steer",
    "cli": "python -m refactory_dsh.console steer",
    "panel": "Steering and user gate controls."
  },
  "parameters": {
    "adopt": {
      "default": false,
      "description": "write the run's current winner as a package now, without ending the run",
      "flags": [
        "--adopt"
      ],
      "nargs": 0,
      "positional": false,
      "required": false,
      "type": "boolean"
    },
    "as_name": {
      "default": null,
      "description": "with --adopt, the package name to write (default: <package>_adopted)",
      "flags": [
        "--as"
      ],
      "nargs": null,
      "positional": false,
      "required": false,
      "type": "string"
    },
    "gates": {
      "default": false,
      "description": "also report the `user` gates this run is stopped at, and the verdicts each accepts, so a caller can offer the answer the gate routes on",
      "flags": [
        "--gates"
      ],
      "nargs": 0,
      "positional": false,
      "required": false,
      "type": "boolean"
    },
    "keep": {
      "default": null,
      "description": "follow this candidate up: it stays a parent even once a newer batch outscores it, and a rejection on it is cleared",
      "flags": [
        "--keep"
      ],
      "nargs": null,
      "positional": false,
      "required": false,
      "type": "string"
    },
    "kind": {

      "description": "a constraint must be respected; the others are context",
      "enum": [
        "info",
        "correction",
        "constraint"
      ],
      "flags": [
        "--kind"
      ],
      "nargs": null,
      "positional": false,
      "required": false,
      "type": "string"
    },
    "lineage": {
      "default": false,
      "description": "with --keep or --reject, act on the candidate's descendants too, so a whole branch is followed up or dropped",
      "flags": [
        "--lineage"
      ],
      "nargs": 0,
      "positional": false,
      "required": false,
      "type": "boolean"
    },
    "note": {
      "default": null,
      "description": "something said while it runs",
      "flags": [
        "--note"
      ],
      "nargs": null,
      "positional": false,
      "required": false,
      "type": "string"
    },
    "pause": {
      "default": false,
      "description": "hold the run at its next generation boundary until resumed or stopped",
      "flags": [
        "--pause"
      ],
      "nargs": 0,
      "positional": false,
      "required": false,
      "type": "boolean"
    },
    "project": {
      "default": null,
      "description": "repository root (default: found)",
      "flags": [
        "--project"
      ],
      "nargs": null,
      "positional": false,
      "required": false,
      "type": "string"
    },
    "reject": {
      "default": null,
      "description": "stop searching around this candidate: it leaves the leaderboard, so it cannot be proposed from, reported best or adopted",
      "flags": [
        "--reject"
      ],
      "nargs": null,
      "positional": false,

      "type": "string"
    },
```

## annealing_pack/anneal

hill-climb a greedy circle packing by accepting non-worsening moves. Inspect declared ports and Task inputs before launch. Optimize only when scored; higher is better.

```json
{
  "description": "hill-climb a greedy circle packing by accepting non-worsening moves",
  "edges": [
    {
      "condition": null,
      "source": "accept_or_revert",
      "target": "iterations_gate"
    },
    {
      "condition": "proceed",
      "source": "iterations_gate",
      "target": "finish"
    },
    {
      "condition": "loop",
      "source": "iterations_gate",
      "target": "perturb_circle"
    },
    {
      "condition": null,
      "source": "perturb_circle",
      "target": "accept_or_revert"
    },
    {
      "condition": null,
      "source": "seed_placement",
      "target": "perturb_circle"
    }
  ],
  "gates": [
    {
      "id": "iterations_gate",
      "user": false
    }
  ],
  "guidance": "",
  "id": "annealing_pack/anneal",
  "nodes": [
    {
      "call": "refactory_packages.annealing_pack.ops:accept_or_revert",
      "id": "accept_or_revert",
      "kind": "op",
      "knobs": [],
      "notes": "keep the move when the task score does not fall",
      "role": "ceo"
    },
    {
      "call": "refactory_packages.annealing_pack.ops:finish",
      "id": "finish",
      "kind": "op",
      "knobs": [],
      "notes": "publish the best score and the best placement",
      "role": "ceo"
    },
    {
      "call": "refactory_packages.annealing_pack.ops:iterations_gate",
      "gate_kind": "fn",
      "id": "iterations_gate",
      "kind": "gate",
      "knobs": [
        "iterations"
      ],
      "notes": "loop while iterations remain, then proceed to the result",
      "role": "ceo"
    },
    {
      "call": "refactory_packages.annealing_pack.ops:perturb_circle",
      "id": "perturb_circle",
      "kind": "op",
      "knobs": [
        "step",
        "seed"
      ],
      "notes": "move one random circle by a small offset and score the result",
      "role": "ceo"
    },
    {
      "call": "refactory_packages.annealing_pack.ops:seed_placement",
      "id": "seed_placement",
      "kind": "op",
      "knobs": [],
      "notes": "seed the working and best placement from the greedy packer",
      "role": "ceo"
    }
  ],
  "parameters": {
    "iterations": {
      "default": 200,
      "description": "how many single-circle moves the gate lets the loop run",
      "frozen": false,
      "kind": "int",
      "range": [
        1,
        400
      ],
      "value": 200,
      "values": []
    },
    "seed": {
      "default": 7,
      "description": "the per-move RNG seed; frozen so a run reproduces",
      "frozen": true,
      "kind": "int",
      "range": [
        null,
        null
      ],
      "value": 7,
      "values": []
    },
    "step": {
      "default": 0.02,
      "description": "half-width of the uniform offset applied to the chosen circle",
      "frozen": false,
      "kind": "float",
      "range": [
        0.001,
        0.25
      ],
      "value": 0.02,
      "values": []
    }
  },
  "ports": [],
  "scored": true,
  "usage": {
    "doc": "refactory/docs/concepts.md",
    "examples": [
      {
        "explanation": "A small starting configuration; use a fresh workdir and inspect required ports and user gates before launch.",
        "knobs": {
          "iterations": 200,
          "seed": 7,
          "step": 0.02
        }
      }
    ],
    "interfaces": {
      "chat": "wf_open mode=annealing_pack/anneal; use refactory help topic=annealing_pack/anneal first",
      "cli": "refactory ceo annealing_pack/anneal",
      "panel": "Mode picker; Run once executes enabled modes including authoring; Optimize requires a scored mode. Use chat for stepwise gates."
    },
    "purpose": "hill-climb a greedy circle packing by accepting non-worsening moves. Inspect declared ports and Task inputs before launch. Optimize only when scored; higher is better.",
    "reviewed_schema": "5525d21774439d37661d6d5f8c0c7377a861819fc47e0819fffe0a3775d3e575"
  }
}
```

## circle_packing/adaptive

population search over circle placements with a budget gate. Inspect declared ports and Task inputs before launch. Optimize only when scored; higher is better.

```json
{
  "description": "population search over circle placements with a budget gate",
  "edges": [
    {
      "condition": null,
      "source": "accept",
      "target": "select_parent"
    },
    {
      "condition": "reloop",
      "source": "budget_check",
      "target": "eval"
    },
    {
      "condition": "proceed",
      "source": "budget_check",
      "target": "exit"
    },
    {
      "condition": null,
      "source": "eval",
      "target": "accept"
    },
    {
      "condition": null,
      "source": "generate",
      "target": "budget_check"
    },
    {
      "condition": null,
      "source": "seed_run",
      "target": "select_parent"
    },
    {
      "condition": null,
      "source": "select_parent",
      "target": "generate"
    },
    {
      "condition": null,
      "source": "task_input",
      "target": "seed_run"
    }
  ],
  "gates": [
    {
      "id": "budget_check",
      "user": false
    }
  ],
  "guidance": "This pipeline's generator is deterministic, so raising `budget` alone re-evaluates the same candidate. The score moves on `order` and `grid`, and on adding a step that varies the sample -- the `restart_on_stall` block. `acceptance_mode` and `selector` move it little.",
  "id": "circle_packing/adaptive",
  "nodes": [
    {
      "call": "refactory_packages.circle_packing.ops:accept_or_reject",
      "id": "accept",
      "kind": "op",
      "knobs": [
        "acceptance_mode"
      ],
      "notes": "keep the candidate when it beats its parent",
      "role": "ceo"
    },
    {
      "call": "refactory_packages.circle_packing.ops:budget_check",
      "gate_kind": "fn",
      "id": "budget_check",
      "kind": "gate",
      "knobs": [],
      "notes": "reloop while budget remains",
      "role": "ceo"
    },
    {
      "call": "refactory_packages.circle_packing.ops:evaluate_candidate",
      "id": "eval",
      "kind": "op",
      "knobs": [],
      "notes": "score the candidate with the task's rule",
      "role": "ceo"
    },
    {
      "call": "refactory_packages.circle_packing.ops:finish",
      "id": "exit",
      "kind": "op",
      "knobs": [],
      "notes": "publish the number the outer loop maximizes",
      "role": "ceo"
    },
    {
      "call": "refactory_packages.circle_packing.ops:generate",
      "id": "generate",
      "kind": "op",
      "knobs": [
        "grid",
        "order",
        "seed"
      ],
      "notes": "draw the next candidate from the resolved generator settings",
      "role": "ceo"
    },
    {
      "call": "refactory_packages.circle_packing.ops:seed_run",
      "id": "seed_run",
      "kind": "op",
      "knobs": [],
      "notes": "seed the population with the task's own baseline heuristic",
      "role": "ceo"
    },
    {
      "call": "refactory_packages.circle_packing.ops:select_parent",
      "id": "select_parent",
      "kind": "op",
      "knobs": [
        "selector",
        "seed"
      ],
      "notes": "choose the individual the next candidate comes from",
      "role": "ceo"
    },
    {
      "call": "refactory_packages.circle_packing.ops:task_input",
      "id": "task_input",
      "kind": "op",
      "knobs": [
        "budget"
      ],
      "notes": "write the instance and open the budget",
      "role": "ceo"
    }
  ],
  "parameters": {
    "acceptance_mode": {
      "default": "strict",
      "description": "how much better than its parent a candidate must be",
      "frozen": false,
      "kind": "enum",
      "range": [
        null,
        null
      ],
      "value": "strict",
      "values": [
        "strict",
        "lenient",
        "off"
      ]
    },
    "budget": {
      "default": 3,
      "description": "how many candidates the ladder may evaluate",
      "frozen": false,
      "kind": "int",
      "range": [
        1,
        8
      ],
      "value": 3,
      "values": []
    },
    "grid": {
      "default": 10,
      "description": "grid resolution the placements are drawn from",
      "frozen": false,
      "kind": "enum",
      "range": [
        null,
        null
      ],
      "value": 10,
      "values": [
        6,
        10,
        14,
        18,
        24
      ]
    },
    "order": {
      "default": "desc",
      "description": "whether the largest or the smallest circles are placed first",
      "frozen": false,
      "kind": "enum",
      "range": [
        null,
        null
      ],
      "value": "desc",
      "values": [
        "desc",
        "asc"
      ]
    },
    "seed": {
      "default": 7,
      "description": "the generator's random seed; frozen so a run reproduces",
      "frozen": true,
      "kind": "int",
      "range": [
        null,
        null
      ],
      "value": 7,
      "values": []
    },
    "selector": {
      "default": "best",
      "description": "how the parent for the next candidate is chosen",
      "frozen": false,
      "kind": "enum",
      "range": [
        null,
        null
      ],
      "value": "best",
      "values": [
        "best",
        "tournament",

      ]
    }
  },

    "purpose": "population search over circle placements with a budget gate. Inspect declared ports and Task inputs before launch. Optimize only when scored; higher is better.",
```

## counting_pack/fixed_step

count up to a target in fixed steps; no RNG, so no seed knob. Inspect declared ports and Task inputs before launch. Optimize only when scored; higher is better.

```json
{
  "description": "count up to a target in fixed steps; no RNG, so no seed knob",
  "edges": [
    {
      "condition": "proceed",
      "source": "check",
      "target": "finish"
    },
    {
      "condition": "retry",
      "source": "check",
      "target": "step"
    },
    {
      "condition": null,
      "source": "start",
      "target": "step"
    },
    {
      "condition": null,
      "source": "step",
      "target": "check"
    }
  ],
  "gates": [
    {
      "id": "check",
      "user": false
    }
  ],
  "guidance": "`step` is the lever: the count overshoots the target whenever `step` does not divide it, so moving `step` moves `closeness` directly. `step = 1` always lands exactly on the target. This mode has no RNG, so there is no seed knob.",
  "id": "counting_pack/fixed_step",
  "nodes": [
    {
      "call": "refactory_packages.counting_pack.ops:check",
      "gate_kind": "fn",
      "id": "check",
      "kind": "gate",
      "knobs": [],
      "notes": "retry while the count is below the target, then proceed to the result",
      "role": "ceo"
    },
    {
      "call": "refactory_packages.counting_pack.ops:finish",
      "id": "finish",
      "kind": "op",
      "knobs": [],
      "notes": "publish the count the run reached, the number of steps it took, and closeness = 1 / (1 + abs(final_count - target))",
      "role": "ceo"
    },
    {
      "call": "refactory_packages.counting_pack.ops:start",
      "id": "start",
      "kind": "op",
      "knobs": [
        "target"
      ],
      "notes": "open the count at zero, record the target the gate stops at, and begin the empty trace; the same op serves both modes",
      "role": "ceo"
    },
    {
      "call": "refactory_packages.counting_pack.ops:step_fixed",
      "id": "step",
      "kind": "op",
      "knobs": [
```

## default_pack/create_fidelity

Opt-in 29-stage Create-v2 fidelity candidate with DSH directors and independent children, human strategy approval, complete QA reports, repair and native portable package admission. Update/plugin variants and live fidelity remain unsupported or unverified.

```json
  "guidance": "The score is what Lean accepted, so no structural edit can raise it: only a proof the checker passes can. The retry gate rotates through the strategies, so `attempts` decides whether a run gets there at all and `strategy` decides whether it gets there on the first try, which is worth 0.1. `library` switches to the mathlib problem, which needs the `mathlib` tool and is where the default strategy fails.",

      "gate_kind": "fn",

      "kind": "gate",
      "knobs": [
        "attempts"
      ],
      "notes": "reloop while an untried strategy remains",
      "role": "ceo"
    },
    {

      "id": "scaffold",
      "kind": "op",
      "knobs": [

    {

      "kind": "op",

    {
      "call": "refactory_packages.lean_pack.ops:check_with_lean",
      "id": "verify",
      "kind": "op",
      "knobs": [
```

```json
      "kind": "op",
```

```json
        "candidates",
        "route"
      ],
      "notes": "derive one closed form and check the conjectures for it exactly",
```
